primary.title: My Life and Work
primary.author: Henry Ford
primary.rationale: Autobiographical account of Ford's life, philosophy, and business practices. Widely available and influential.

primary.title: The Dearborn Independent
primary.author: Henry Ford
primary.rationale: A newspaper owned and heavily influenced by Henry Ford, containing many of his views and editorials. Contains controversial content.

primary.title: Today and Tomorrow
primary.author: Henry Ford
primary.rationale: A follow-up to 'My Life and Work,' discussing his thoughts on the future of industry and society.

secondary.title: The Machine in the Garden: Technology and the Pastoral Ideal in America
secondary.author: Leo Marx
secondary.rationale: While published before 1976, this seminal work provides crucial context for understanding Ford's impact on American culture and the pastoral ideal. Its influence warrants its inclusion.

secondary.title: Henry Ford: A Biography
secondary.author: Peter Collier
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive biography offering critical analysis of Ford's life and legacy.

secondary.title: The American Automobile: A Diverse History of the Automotive Industry
secondary.author: Robert J. Neal
secondary.rationale: A scholarly overview of the American automotive industry, likely containing significant analysis of Henry Ford's contributions and impact.

suggestions.notes: Henry Ford's primary writings are often found in books that have entered the public domain. Secondary sources should focus on academic analyses of his business practices, labor relations, and broader cultural impact.
